pages.text: The $(l)Gem of Eternal Density$() turns low-value items in your inventory into a target material. Craft it from diamonds, Dark Matter and obsidian. It fits the necklace curio slot.$(br2)Press $(l)G$() to cycle the target: Iron, Gold, Diamond, Dark Matter or Red Matter.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)While active it eats up to half a stack at a time of items worth less than the target and builds the target item from their EMC.$(li)$(l)Right-click$() opens a whitelist/blacklist screen so you can protect items.$(li)$(l)Shift + right-click$() toggles it on and off; turning it off drops the items it consumed back on the ground and clears its stored EMC.$(li)It only condenses items already in your inventory, not loose drops.
